integral_reading: torsion-free; homotopy type is a wedge of81 circles and40 two-spheres

carrier_identifications.C2: 240 undirected W33 edges; each square in a line-cube is indexed by one unordered pair of the four W33 points on that line

topological_reason: The complex is the union of40 cube-boundary two-spheres. Only the four point-cover vertices of each sphere are shared; the attachment incidence graph has40 point nodes,40 line-sphere nodes and160 incidences, hence cycle rank160-80+1=81, while each sphere contributes one H2 generator.
theorem: The glued eight-cover cubes give a canonical finite complex with H=(1,81,40), providing an intrinsic 81-dimensional homology sector on the 480 directed-edge carrier.
